findings.message: Error message changed from 'page number must be >= 1' to 'page number must be positive' — while both are technically correct for positive integers, 'positive' is ambiguous (could include non-integers) and less precise than '>= 1'.
findings.suggestion: Revert to 'page number must be >= 1' for clarity and precision

findings.message: Loop condition uses <= which causes an off-by-one error, leading to an out-of-bounds slice access when i equals start+len(pageRows)
findings.suggestion: Change the loop condition from i <= start+len(pageRows) to i < start+len(pageRows)
